name: Reunification Palace
kicker: Palace on the old Norodom site
summary: Palace on the old Norodom site: walk the halls and the basement command rooms, open 07:00–18:00. Ngô Viết Thụ designed the building you enter, at 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa. Palace-only is 40,000 đồng. The palace plus the exhibition is 80,000 đồng, and an adult ticket is also listed at 80,000 đồng.
fee: 40,000 đồng for the palace alone. 80,000 đồng for an adult.
getThere: Walk from Đồng Khởi or Nguyễn Huệ.
heroCaption: The facade, the lawn, and the fountain

notice.title: 80,000 đồng is the palace plus the exhibition
notice.body: 80,000 đồng covers the palace plus the exhibition. Palace-only is 40,000 đồng. An adult ticket is also 80,000 đồng. Another listed figure is 15,000 đồng.

body: The building you walk was designed by Ngô Viết Thụ on the site of Dinh Norodom. The historical mark is 30 April 1975. In 1976 the building was called Hội trường Thống Nhất, and that name is still used for the managing body. The Norodom start is dated 23 February 1868, finished in 1871. The special-national ranking is Decision 1272/QĐ-TTg of 12 August 2009, after a national ranking by Decision 77A/VHQĐ of 25 June 1976. The grounds cover 120,000 square metres and hold more than 3,700 objects.

The basement command center and the war rooms are the part to keep time for. One suggested order is the Norodom display of 1868 first, then the rooms of the 1966 building. Cà phê sữa đá in the park outside, on a Saturday morning, is before you go in. That coffee is outside the ticket.

figures.caption: The same facade and fountain from the lawn, in a different hour
figures.alt: Reunification Palace facade and fountain seen across the lawn

gettingThere: The addresses are 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa and 106 Nguyễn Du, Phường Bến Thành. The older label is 135 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, Ben Thanh, District 1. From Đồng Khởi or Nguyễn Huệ you walk. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 2.7 km.

legs.heading: From Đồng Khởi or Nguyễn Huệ

hours: Visiting hours are 07:00–18:00 every day. Gate 135 sells tickets 07:00–18:00 and gate 106 sells tickets 08:00–16:00, including holidays. A posted closure can change the day. Another clock is 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m.
closed: Open every day unless a special notice closes the building.
admissionNote: From 1 August 2025. Combo “Hành Trình Trọn Vẹn,” palace plus exhibition plus buggy: adult 105,000 đồng, age 60 or over or a Vietnamese student 65,000, child 6–17 45,000. Combo “Hành Trình Lịch Sử,” palace plus exhibition: adult 80,000, age 60 or a Vietnamese student 40,000, child 6–17 20,000. Combo “Trải Nghiệm Tiện Lợi,” palace plus buggy: adult 65,000, age 60 or a Vietnamese student 45,000, child 6–17 35,000. Combined palace and exhibition: adult 80,000, Vietnamese student 40,000, child 20,000. Palace only: adult 40,000, Vietnamese student 20,000, child 10,000. Buggy 25,000 đồng a ride. A guide from 350,000 đồng. Photo permission from 1,000,000 đồng. “Khám phá Di sản” from 20,000 đồng. A shorter list: adult 80,000, student or older person 40,000, child from 6 to under 16 20,000. Child bands are 6–17 and from 6 to under 16. Another listed adult figure is 15,000 đồng.
